# Help The Hive

> Budget meal planning for real families. Free forever for SNAP, WIC, military, and teacher families — and anyone planning meals on a budget. We plan your week, build your grocery list, and help you shop in under 5 minutes.

Help The Hive turns your weekly grocery budget and the store you already shop at into a 6-day batch-cooking meal plan with an organized shopping list. Users can send the list directly to Instacart. The platform is 100% free — no subscriptions, no premium tiers — funded by Instacart affiliate revenue, sponsored brands, and grants.
